title: Once-weekly semaglutide doubles the five-year risk of nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy in a Danish cohort of 424,152 persons with type 2 diabetes
authors: Grauslund J, Taha AA, Molander LD, Kawasaki R, Möller S, Højlund K, et al.
journal: International Journal of Retina and Vitreous
population: All persons with type 2 diabetes in Denmark; 106,454 exposed to once-weekly semaglutide; median age 65 years, 54.5% men
authorConflicts: The authors declare no competing interests.
result: 218 persons developed NAION, 67 of them exposed to semaglutide. Incidence 0.228 per 1000 person-years with semaglutide exposure against 0.093 without; adjusted hazard ratio 2.19 (95% CI 1.54 to 3.12). Median time from first prescription to NAION 22.2 months (IQR 10.2 to 37.8). Smoking, blood pressure and BMI were not available for adjustment, and ophthalmic examinations were not accessible.
